name: Laboratory DC Bench Voltmeter (0-3V)
semanticDescription: Laboratory-grade DC moving-coil voltmeter (0 to 3 V scale with bold V emblem) for measuring electric potential difference in parallel circuits (NCERT Class 10 Science Chapter 11 Electricity and Class 12 Physics Chapter 4). Features dual presentation collections: Voltmeter_Full (complete bench instrument in molded black Bakelite casing, front glass window, crimson needle indicating 2.4 V, mechanical zero-adjustment screw, top knurled brass binding posts on studio slate plinth) and Voltmeter_Section (cutaway revealing internal electromechanical movement: moving coil galvanometer assembly, high-resistance wire-wound multiplier resistor bobbin R in series with the coil, series connecting leads routing potential difference V = Ig * (G + R), and educational plaque on brass stanchions).
simplifications: Multiplier resistor represented as precision ceramic bobbin with fine resistance alloy winding.
Internal copper leads routed cleanly for pedagogical clarity.

materials.look: Molded black phenolic Bakelite instrument casing
Crisp white matte printed scale face with 0-3V graduations and bold V
Crimson red lightweight aluminum indicator pointer
High-luster enameled copper magnet wire turns
Concave cylindrical North (red) and South (blue) permanent magnet pole shoes
Dark studio slate display pedestal with satin gold trim
